name: Saratoga Springs Newcomers 2024
information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competition Procedures](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaratogaSpringsNewcomers2024#36860-competition-procedures) and [New Competitor FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaratogaSpringsNewcomers2024#36861-new-competitor-faq) tab.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcHhpIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--0030a62d70c3135d4afc414666717da46eabefef/SaratogaSpringsCubikon.jpg)

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! Due to venue capacity limits, we ask that no more than 1 guest per cuber during the morning hours. No guest limit after Noon. No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years of age.

This competition is a part of the WCA Newcomer Month initiative. Please refer to the WCA Newcomer Month Information tab for more information.
